Learn moreOnline multiplayer on console requires XBOX Game Pass Essential, Premium, or Ultimate (subscriptions sold separately).DETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionBOMBANANA! Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode? - 3-Player Co-op: No more, no less. Exactly three monkeys required. - 3 Game Modes: - Campaign: 30 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty. - Endless: Procedurally generated, wave-based levels that keep getting harder. - Custom: Players create their own challenge by adjusting bomb difficulty, the timer, module types, environmental hazards, and how many mistakes are allowed. - Asymmetric Roles: Every player sees, hears, and acts differently. - Fun interactions: Point, wave, gesture or flail wildly. Your options are only limited by your imagination and each player's Emote wheel. - Slapping: Obviously an essential feature. - New Environments: We all know the trusty minivan, but what about a plane? What other environments can you defuse bombs in? - Environmental Hazards: Navigate events like power outages, obstructions and loud interruptions. - Voice Chat: Some of you can talk, some of you can’t. You’ll figure it out. - Puzzle Modules: Each bomb has different modules and different rules, all of which are guaranteed to induce different kinds of panic. - Level System: Defuse the bomb to unlock new levels. The better you get, the harder they are. - Color Blind Mode: Just because the monkey is blind, doesn’t mean he can’t defuse a bomb! Colors used across objects and the UI have been adapted to support two different types of color blindness. source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Alcohol and Tobacco Reference, Comic Mischief, Mild Fantasy Violence, Mild LanguageUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesGamesSpirit CrossingReleases 11/16/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalSale ends: 11/21/26 at 07:59 a.m. UTCAlcohol and Tobacco Reference, Comic Mischief, Mild Fantasy Violence, Mild LanguageUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesLoadingWelcome to your strange new home.Glide through pastel clouds, heal troubled spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend.In Spirit Crossing, you can play together or by yourself, for as long as you like. Each stranger you befriend blooms into color, revealing the unique person behind their gray shadow. Make a friend, or just quietly share the same little corner of the world. Our game is built around small acts of kindness, and the way even brief connections can make us feel a little less alone.Show off your style with hundreds of hairstyles, dyes, head coverings, prosthetics, and mix-and-match outfits, then bring it all to life with dozens of expressive emotes. Come as you are, or try on someone new! Then design the ultimate space to host your friends, from cozy cottage to full-blown castle. Fill it with enough furniture, plants, rugs, lamps, and tiny trinkets to ensure no shelf goes tragically undecorated.From Spry Fox:Spirit Crossing has been in development for over five years. At the heart of this project is our belief that games should bring people together, encourage kindness, and reduce loneliness in this chaotic world we live in.Software description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):This product can only be played on Nintendo Switch™ 2.
